title: Permutations
statement_short: Given an array nums of distinct integers, return all the possible permutations. You can return the answer in any order.
constraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 6, -10 <= nums[i] <= 10, all integers of nums are unique
hint: Very small array length (<= 6) permits recursive search across all n! element orderings.
why_not: Right: Backtracking builds ordering paths recursively by swapping/tracking used elements in O(n \* n!) time. Not Sorting: Sorting orders elements value-wise, but does not enumerate all permutation orderings. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers shrink or expand sub-arrays rather than swapping elements into all permutation arrangements. Not 1D DP: State memoization counts total permutation counts, but explicit enumeration requires path backtracking.
